about: Figma source of truth for the shared LevelMap screen contract (PLAY + the SHOP | HOME | LOCK bottom navigation) of READY_UI_STYLE_1 (style-1) and READY_UI_STYLE_2 (style-2). Read 2026-10-06 through the Figma MCP: get_metadata, read-only use_figma dumps, download_assets (component PNG@1x exports) and get_screenshot with contentsOnly (transparent renders). Coordinates are Figma units = Ready UI design units (both frames are 2344 high like the portrait design box). Item geometry is relative to the slot centre (x) and the TOP of the nav panel rect (y), like ReadyUiSkinBottomNavLayout.
